title: LinkedIn profile enrichment API for one B2B lead
description: LinkedIn profile enrichment API for one B2B lead

_signals.x_guidance: Use POST /agent/v1/profiles/enrich for bulk LinkedIn profile enrichment and B2B lead enrichment. Use GET /agent/v1/profiles/enrich for one LinkedIn profile, GET /agent/v1/profiles/email for verified work-email lookup, and GET /agent/v1/posts/reactions for LinkedIn post engagement. Call a paid route without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, sign the x402 USDC challenge, then retry the same URL with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. The API is read-only.
